name: Inventor
source: Written by Vorthas for Monster Builder for Pathfinder 2e, after Pathfinder GM Core's Class Road Maps ("Building Creatures")
license: GPL-3.0-or-later, like the rest of this app; the Pathfinder rules terms it uses are Paizo's ORC-licensed material.
rules: Low Perception; high Crafting; high Int; high AC (Extreme if Armor Innovation); low to moderate HP; Overdrive, Explode, Shield Block; moderate attack and high damage (Extreme damage for weapon innovation); add a construct to the encounter for construct innovation; Inventor innovation, modifications to gear to reflect modifications

notes.defense: High AC (extreme with an armor innovation); low to moderate HP.
notes.offense: Moderate attack bonus and high damage (extreme with a weapon innovation).
notes.specials: Overdrive, Explode, Shield Block; inventor innovation, with modifications to its gear to reflect them; add a construct to the encounter for a construct innovation.
